# About Network Events

**Source:** https://help.zscaler.com/zscaler-cellular/about-network-events
**Captured:** 2026-08-12 via Zscaler Help `/zapi/fetch-data` JSON (`body.content`) extraction.

---

The Zscaler Cellular Network Events page centralizes network and authorization
events for all SIMs provisioned to the organization. It is intended for
connectivity monitoring and troubleshooting, including transitions between
online and offline state.

On **Infrastructure > Connectors > Cellular > Network Events**, administrators
can filter events, refresh without clearing filters, choose preset or custom
date ranges, configure columns, and paginate results.

Event rows expose:

- ICCID, EID, and IMSI identifiers;
- event timestamp;
- country and network operator; and
- category: session start, session end, online/offline status, or authorization.

The page supports 10, 20, or 50 records per page. The captured article does not
state retention, export, or streaming behavior.
